paper.title_en: Thermal Metastable Strings in One-Scale Models and Gravitational Waves
paper.abstract_en: Metastable cosmic strings provide a cosmological interpretation of the nanohertz stochastic gravitational wave background reported by Pulsar Timing Array (PTA) experiments. We revisit this scenario in a minimal dark-sector gauge theory, in which a complex Higgs doublet breaks $\mathrm{SU}(2)\times\mathrm{U}(1)\to\mathrm{U}(1)_{\rm IR}$ at a single symmetry-breaking scale. This one-scale setup predicts metastable $Z$-strings whose endpoints are monopole-like defects, and whose zero-temperature decay rate is controlled by the gauge couplings and mass ratios. We show that, once the string-forming transition occurs in a thermal plasma, the dominant decay channel is not the zero-temperature monopole nucleation but thermally induced nucleation on the string worldsheet. We determine the nucleation temperature $T_{\rm nuc}$, which we \rev{adopt as the reference string-formation scale}, from the one-loop finite-temperature effective potential with daisy resummation, and use it to evaluate the worldsheet bounce action throughout the model parameter space. \rev{Requiring a PTA-compatible gravitational wave} signal selects a narrow region in the model parameter space, in the $(\sin^2θ_w,\sqrtβ)$ plane, where $θ_w$ is the dark-sector weak mixing angle and $β\equiv M_Φ^2/M_{Z}^2$ is the squared Higgs-to-$Z$ mass ratio. Thermal effects modify the zero-temperature picture significantly, shifting the PTA-compatible region towards lower values of the dark fine-structure constant $α'$ and larger values of the monopole-to-string-tension ratio $κ$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在单尺度暗区规范理论中重新审视亚稳态宇宙弦解释PTA纳赫兹随机引力波背景的情景，首次强调热等离子体中的热诱导成核主导衰变，并系统计算了一维有限温度有效势、daisy重求和、世界面反弹作用及PTA兼容参数区域，与PTA主题高度相关且理论深度与方法严谨性较强，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 单尺度模型中的热亚稳态弦与引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 亚稳态宇宙弦为脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）实验报告的纳赫兹随机引力波背景提供了一种宇宙学解释。我们在一个最小暗区规范理论中重新审视这一情景，其中复希格斯二重态在单一对称性破缺能标处将$\mathrm{SU}(2)\times\mathrm{U}(1)$破缺为$\mathrm{U}(1)_{\rm IR}$。这一单尺度设定预言了亚稳态$Z$弦，其端点为类磁单极缺陷，且其零温衰变率由规范耦合和质量比控制。我们表明，一旦成弦相变发生在热等离子体中，主导衰变通道不是零温磁单极成核，而是弦世界面上的热诱导成核。我们利用带daisy重求和的一圈有限温度有效势确定成核温度$T_{\rm nuc}$，并将其作为参考成弦能标，进而用它评估整个模型参数空间中的世界面反弹作用。要求PTA兼容的引力波信号在模型参数空间中选出一个狭窄区域，即在$(\sin^2θ_w,\sqrtβ)$平面内，其中$θ_w$是暗区弱混合角，$β\equiv M_Φ^2/M_{Z}^2$是希格斯与$Z$质量平方比。热效应显著改变了零温图像，将PTA兼容区域推向更低的暗精细结构常数$α'$值和更大的磁单极与弦张力比$κ$值。
